method: 10,000 paired bootstrap resamples of public panorama load median ratios, seed 12345. Seven repeats, baseline above 10 ms and an interval above 1 required for a stable reduction. Includes WebGL context, Blob snapshot, image decoding and DOM setup; excludes scheduled drawing/upload, source/module preparation and post-timer content checks. Complete Blob/pixel equivalence checked in every run. No peer/SOTA or peak-memory claim.
